topic: National student strike on 25 Oct 2026 over cost of living and education quality, plus university and school protests on 22 Oct 2026 against Azerbaijan's hijab restrictions
scale: University and school protests across several Iraqi provinces (Anbar, Basra, Dhi Qar, Najaf, Maysan) on 22 Oct, and a nationwide student strike on 25 Oct
quote1: We call on the Iraqi government to guarantee students’ exercise of their right to strike on 25 October, and to provide the necessary conditions for it, including protecting demonstrators and strikers and ensuring they are not subjected to violence or arbitrary arrest.
quote2: Universities and schools across several Iraqi provinces staged protests on Thursday against Azerbaijan's restrictions on wearing the hijab, calling for respect for religious freedom and women's right to wear headscarves.
